title: fix: crop sweep attaches a reader surface

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: crop sweep attaches a reader surface

description: The crop parity leg opened a preview session but never attached a surface. The crop parameters switch the window pass on, and since 2b1e2ff a window draw with no attached surface fails the present and the JNI seam returns null, so all 21 cases were skipped (cases=0). The sweep now attaches a throwaway ImageReader surface (drained by a listener so the swap never blocks) and detaches and closes it afterwards. Device run: cases=21 skipped=0; results are in the status report. No thresholds changed.
changed: fix: crop sweep attaches a reader surface
